2842-4279-4976--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2842-4279-4976--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3234-3293-3899-4693.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-3899-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-3899-4693.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

997-3197-6566--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-2073-5226-7880.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Elven Bow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Elven Bow enters, it triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token and attach Elven Bow to it.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Elven Bow.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elf Warrior dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

1558-3478-3875-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3478-3875-4231-7810.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-3455.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-3455.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Vizier of Many Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-3455.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3457-5614-7791.easyPrerequisites: Bighorner Rancher does not have summoning sickness.
3457-5614-7791.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Bighorner Rancher.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat.

851-2557-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1872-2523-2869.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it.
When Composite Golem dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Composite Golem that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Composite Golem token

2724-3080-5163-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Roon of the Hidden Realm by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling and returning (at end step) Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

1818-3490-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-3490-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4316-5078-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2366-5411-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5411-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

5330-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1939-2034-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-2034-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

486-1557-1651-5640.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Siren of the Silent Song to become an artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Siren of the Silent Song, targeting Siren of the Silent Song.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat from step 2.
486-1557-1651-5640.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

549-1651-5640-6858.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Oreskos Sun Guide, targeting Oreskos Sun Guide.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat
549-1651-5640-6858.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

3470-5411-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
3470-5411-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger that many times.
Resolve all Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-5478-5700-5701-6517.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5478-5700-5701-6517.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2173-2573-4423-4693-6491.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
2173-2573-4423-4693-6491.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
2173-2573-4423-4693-6491.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
2173-2573-4423-4693-6491.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

2493-2792-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
2493-2792-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Archaeomancer and Great Whale, targeting Archaeomancer
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Great Whale.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Archaeomancer and Great Whale tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

1308-2793-3017-3743-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
1308-2793-3017-3743-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

372-2072-2187.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Scrollshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2072-2187.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4222-5724.notablePrerequisites: Sage of the Maze does not have summoning sickness.
4222-5724.description:
Activate Sage of the Maze's first ability by tapping it, adding {U} and one mana of any color.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sage of the Maze.
Repeat.

1257-1323-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Walking Atlas each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
1257-1323-4543.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Walking Atlas's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Experiment Kraj.
Repeat.

97-2034-2308-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Beast.
97-2034-2308-4772.description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing another Beast, causing you to gain 4 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create two 4/4 Fungus Beast creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

1110-2178-4147-4294.manaNeeded: {5}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1110-2178-4147-4294.notablePrerequisites:
It is your precombat main phase.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
1110-2178-4147-4294.description:
Cast Etali from your hand or from the command zone by paying {5}{R}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it and Terror of the Peaks trigger.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage equal to Etali's power to Etali.
Etali dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from step 2.
If you decide to cast any other creature spells using Etali's trigger, Terror of the Peaks will trigger for each of them, dealing damage equal to the creature's power to any target.

222-2648-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-2648-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Phyrexian Triniform and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}.
When Phyrexian Triniform dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Phyrexian Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Phyrexian Golems, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Phyrexian Triniform from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

687-2034-2086-3818.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Kitchen Finks dies, triggering its persist ability and Sengir's first ability.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Sengir trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Sengir, and both counters from Kitchen Finks.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-5 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 6, causing you to mill three cards and returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

628-997-1242.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

703-2144.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Astral Dragon to die.
703-2144.description:
Cause Astral Dragon to die.
Myrkul triggers, exiling Astral Dragon and creating a token copy of it that's an enchantment and loses all other card types.
The Astral Dragon token enters the battlefield, creating two copies of itself that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
The creature Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first Astral Dragon trigger, creating two copies of any applicable permanent that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Resolve the second Astral Dragon trigger, creating two copies of the noncreature Astral Dragon that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 4.

23-776-1306-1329.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1306-1329.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Mana Crypt to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Mana Crypt.
Cast Mana Crypt.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

578-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness. You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Metalworker
578-5200.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, revealing at least two artifact cards in your hand and adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Metalworker
Repeat.
578-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.
